name: music_viz_showcase
description: Showcase of all Strudel visualizer types — open Ctrl+M to watch each one
script: announce STRUDEL VISUALIZER SHOWCASE — watch Ctrl+M
strudel edit "c4 e4 g4 c5".pianoroll() cps=0.5
strudel edit "[c4 e4 g4 c5]*4".pianoroll() cps=0.5
announce 5/14: scope — melody shows pitch changes
strudel edit "c4 e4 g4 c5".scope() cps=0.5
strudel edit "c4 e4 g4 c5".wordfall() cps=0.5
announce 10/14: spiral — melody tracing the spiral
strudel edit "c4 e4 g4 c5 g4 e4".spiral() cps=0.4
announce 11/14: pitchwheel — chromatic notes on circle
strudel edit "c4 d4 e4 f4 g4 a4 b4".pitchwheel() cps=0.5
announce 13/14: fscope — frequency spectrum of melody
strudel edit "c3 e3 g3 c4".fscope() cps=0.5
announce 14/14: fscope — wide range frequency bars
strudel edit "c2 c3 c4 c5".fscope() cps=0.4
notify {SCRIPT} "How did all the visualizers look?" ["Good","Issues","Broken"] {inspect} blocking
